title: Second moment of a linear projection
statement: Let $-1\leq \rho\leq 1$, let $n$ be a positive integer, and let $t=(t_1,t_2)$ be any point of the plane. For a pair of sign vectors sampled by choosing the first uniformly and keeping each coordinate for the second with probability $(1+\rho)/2$, the expected square of the inner product of their normalized sum with $t$ is $t_1^2+2\rho t_1t_2+t_2^2$.
hypotheses_covered: $t$ is an arbitrary point of the plane
